principle: Every record must declare what it is, where it came from, and what authority it does or does not carry.

canonical_course_engine_evidence.description: Evidence calculated by a canonical course or assessment engine from learner responses.

browser_local_course_evidence.description: Course-engine evidence stored in browser localStorage. It may faithfully reflect the local course engine but is editable browser state and is not independently authenticated.

unscoped_browser_unit_evidence.description: Unit evidence stored under a browser-level key that is not bound to a learner identity. It must not be silently attributed to a selected learner profile.

family_entered_information.description: Names, dates, hours, observations, logs, signatures, and other fields entered by a parent, learner, teacher, or administrator.

learner_created_evidence.description: Reflections, notes, handwriting, uploaded work, projects, and other learner-created artifacts.

validated_academic_record.description: A record that has been validated by a protected institutional records workflow with an explicit identity and authority chain.

unit_bridge.reason: Current unit progress keys do not contain or encode a learner identifier.

records_office.rule: Do not silently merge unscoped unit evidence into a learner-scoped family record.
